failure_types.TYPE A: Structural - invalid MIDI header, format, PPQ, tracks
failure_types.TYPE B: Korg compatibility - invalid mapping, range, polyphony
failure_types.TYPE C: Velocity - uncontrolled, clipping, out of range
failure_types.TYPE D: Timing - invalid timing, microtiming beyond safe window
failure_types.TYPE E: Expression - CC11 jumps, clipping, redundant events
failure_types.TYPE J: Musical degradation - technical PASS but musical FAIL

process.reproduce: Reproduce FAIL with same input + config + seed
process.isolate: Isolate cause: which transform, which parameter
